name: dreamcontext Settings › Recall: switching to Hybrid

steps.label: Recall section, default mode
expect: The Recall section of Settings is displayed with its recall-mode options visible
The Haiku option is the currently selected recall mode
The Hybrid option is marked as experimental
The user can pick between at least four recall modes
reject: The Hybrid option is the currently selected recall mode
A model download is shown in progress under the Hybrid option
A GitHub token input field is visible on this screen
An error message is currently displayed

steps.label: Recall section, after choosing Hybrid
expect: The Hybrid option is the currently selected recall mode
A model download is shown in progress under the Hybrid option
The Hybrid option explains that it falls back to BM25 when the embedding model is unavailable
The Hybrid option warns that first use downloads a model of roughly 100 MB
reject: A GitHub token input field is visible on this screen
An error message is currently displayed
